name: Immanence of Set — 1 Basic — Tongue of the Tempter

system.description:
All Followers of Set are chosen for their ability to manipulate mortal and Cainite minds alike, but this power heightens that gift to its utmost, lending the Setite's words a hypnotic sweetness that loosens the tightest lips and releases a victim's innermost desires.

The Setite must invoke this power immediately after sundown, spending two Blood Traits and making a Social Challenge (Manipulation/Empathy) against the target's Willpower. That night, the Setite must seek out the victim and engage him in conversation for at least half an hour. On success, the victim lets slip one of his secret fears or desires sometime during the conversation, without remembering having done so; the number of successes indicates the importance of the secret revealed, at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three
system.prerequisites: Setite Sorcery (Immanence of Set); a Follower of Set in good standing with his temple
